channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.23
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 23
- Fixes editor discovery when an application reports its window or a container as focused. Capture and pre-paste verification now resolve the focused editor consistently inside the original window. - Gives focused-editor discovery its own time budget so scanning a large message list for selected text cannot exhaust it. Keeps the initial focus identity before recording and tolerates an initially unavailable Accessibility window appearing during warm-up, while retaining window and user-input guards. - Adds capture and insertion failure details under Latest text → Focus diagnostics. Diagnostics omit field values, selected text, keystrokes and clipboard contents. Unconfirmed insertion continues to preserve the transcript for recovery. - Removes the old product name from visible instructions and nonessential internal names. Existing signing, permission, Keychain and legacy data identifiers remain compatible; fresh installations create a Pysano signing identity.
## Українською
Виправлено пошук поля введення та перевірку фокусу перед вставленням готової транскрипції. Великі списки повідомлень більше не витрачають час, відведений на пошук поля. У «Останній текст → Діагностика поля введення» доступна конкретна причина відмови без вмісту поля або буфера обміну. Стару назву прибрано з інтерфейсу; сумісність із наявними дозволами, ключем і моделями збережено.
## Verification
100 automated checks, application compilation and 572 localized strings passed validation. Focus regressions cover structural window/container traversal, rejecting unfocused editors, and bounded search. Repeated live dictation and actual paste delivery in Telegram, Codex and browser chats still require acceptance testing; this beta does not claim the intermittent insertion problem is eliminated in every application.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.22
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 22
- Added Russian, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Arabic and Hindi to both Live Translation language selectors: incoming listening and your outgoing meeting voice. - Preserves existing language settings and sends the documented language/region codes to Gemini. - Updates same-language detection for regional language codes so intentional silence with target-language repetition disabled is not mistaken for a stalled translation. - Includes all Beta 21 audio-device routing and translation recovery improvements.
## Українською
В обох списках мов перекладу тепер доступні також російська, німецька, іспанська, португальська (Бразилія та Португалія), китайська (спрощена), японська, арабська та гінді. Збережені налаштування залишаються без змін.
## Verification
98 automated checks and application compilation passed before release preparation. Tests cover each language's API code, settings round-trip and regional language matching. Live audio quality for the newly added languages has not been individually tested. Gemini API usage may incur charges; the long-session and meeting acceptance limitations documented in Beta 21 still apply.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.21
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 21
- Live Translation can capture a selected application, microphone/virtual input, or the first audio stream of a selected output device. Output-device capture excludes Pysano's own playback and preserves the original audio. Translation playback can target a physical or virtual output. - Fixes missing-voice detection: input transcripts and silent PCM no longer hide a stalled translated voice. Adds recovery after capture stops delivering frames and retries transient service errors, with explicit reasons and gap warnings. - Fixes input/output device classification and avoids restarting capture for unrelated audio-device changes. Reuses playback converters and reduces background polling. - Shows input and translated signal, playback queue, recovery count and stale-audio skips. Permanent failures also appear in the menu-bar status. - Recovers idle meeting connections after transient failures. An interrupted spoken phrase prompts you to repeat it instead of silently losing speech or replaying an uncertain phrase. Direct virtual-device feedback routes are blocked. - Keeps the current specialized Gemini Live Translate model. Existing dictation and insertion fixes from Beta 20 are included.
## Для тестування
У налаштуваннях «Переклад наживо» виберіть джерело, мову та пристрій відтворення. Для YouTube спочатку спробуйте «Застосунок» із вашим браузером. Новий режим «Звук вихідного пристрою» захоплює звук усіх застосунків на вибраному виході, крім Pysano; гучність оригіналу в цьому режимі регулюється системою.
Якщо озвучення знову зникне, перевірте індикатор сигналу перекладу, чергу звуку та «Причину останнього відновлення». Повідомте приблизний час від запуску й вибраний маршрут.
## Verification and limitations
97 automated checks, full application compilation and native silent-playback checks passed before release preparation. Sustained YouTube dubbing, actual output-device loopback and two-way meeting acceptance still require live testing. Use headphones with microphone capture. Audio during reconnection gaps is not replayed. Gemini requires internet and may incur API charges. This beta does not claim failure-free translation or verified compatibility with every meeting client.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
